posts.text: A 10x reduction in simulation cost is essentially a hardware leap achieved through software. Agentic research will accelerate anything software can reach.
posts.quoted: Quantum computers could one day transform fusion energy, chemistry, and drug discovery - if we can make the algorithms efficient enough to run on early hardware. Using teams of Gemini 4 agents, we’ve built new quantum circuits that cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times.
